name: agentic/photo-statement
title: Photo Statement
description: A large statement built from fixed lines, each a flowing sentence with pill-shaped photos woven inline between the words (Sleek's "make you look/feel..." section). `lines` is an array of lines; each line is an array of items, either {type:"text", text} or {type:"image", imageUrl, imageAlt, backgroundColor, width, height} — backgroundColor insets the photo on a colored pill, omitting it lets the photo bleed full-size to fill the pill. Line breaks are explicit (not auto-wrapped) so the layout always matches the authored grouping.
